_about: GET /api/risk?hours_ahead=0-24&mode=live|replay. Snowfall on a ~3 km grid over Western New York, as number arrays: snow_total_in[row][col] (storm total, inches) and rate_in_hr[row][col] (inches per hour) at cell centers. Row 0 is the south edge and col 0 the west edge; bounds are the grid's outer edges. Example cut to 2 x 3 cells around the snow band; the real grid is about 53 x 58.
